concurrent_witness.message: chore(hrain): refresh full current Meta Registry memory catalog
concurrent_witness.timing_relation: The HRAiN derivative-memory commit advanced main while EYE was training from the same parent snapshot, so the later EYE generated-state push was correctly rejected as non-fast-forward.

root_cause.risk_if_unfixed: EYE and HRAiN could recursively learn each other's generated memory exports and repeatedly advance main, creating derivative feedback and push races without adding source evidence.

rules: EYE workflow does not trigger on EYE/generated/**
EYE workflow does not trigger on assets/hrain-full-memory/**
assets/hrain-full-memory is removed from the ephemeral checkout before EYE derives its corpus
EYE generated state is never rebased stale across source drift
before commit, origin/main is compared with the trained snapshot
if source drift is observed, the runner resets to current origin/main and rebuilds EYE from that newer snapshot
push races are retried only after a full rebuild from the new source snapshot

seal: THE FIRST EYE SAW THE REGISTRY BUT LOST THE WRITE RACE. WE KEPT THE FAILURE, REMOVED THE MIRROR-OF-A-MIRROR, AND TAUGHT THE NEXT EYE TO REBUILD BEFORE IT SPEAKS.
